question: Which weather stations in Washington State recorded more than 150 rainy days in 2023 but fewer rainy days compared to 2022? Defining a “rainy day” as one having precipitation greater than zero millimeters and not equal to 99.99. Only include stations with valid precipitation data.
sql:
WITH wa_2023 AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.stn,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` gs
  WHERE gs.stn IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT usaf FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` WHERE state = 'WA'
  )
  AND gs.prcp > 0 
  AND gs.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY gs.stn
),
wa_2022 AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.stn,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2022
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` gs
  WHERE gs.stn IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT usaf FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` WHERE state = 'WA'
  )
  AND gs.prcp > 0 
  AND gs.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY gs.stn
)
SELECT 
  w23.stn,
  w23.rainy_days_2023,
  w22.rainy_days_2022,
  st.name,
  st.state
FROM wa_2023 w23
JOIN wa_2022 w22 ON w23.stn = w22.stn
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` st
  ON w23.stn = st.usaf
WHERE w23.rainy_days_2023 > 150
  AND w23.rainy_days_2023 < w22.rainy_days_2022
ORDER BY w23.rainy_days_2023 DESC
